comments.author: xmonk
comments.content:
When I was a kid, my parents had a Bang & Olufsen sound system, I used to listen to record on it every day, amazing system it was, kind of space age futuristic theme at least it was for the 70's.

I like their music system a lot, being a musician and music lover, I'm always on the look out, however they are on the expensive side, and we don't longer have a distributor in my country, so I haven't auditioned the new line. Don't kick the NAD they make killer amps and CD players, of course they might not be in the same league, this days there is a lot of good audiophile quality equipment in the market, China is producing some really nice equipment, and so is Japan at the boutique level.

I'm sure they give an employee discount, or at least I hope they do, so you might get one of those systems, and maybe write a review.

comments.author: monzool
comments.content:
B&O indeed gives employee discounts and finance options, but a couple of BeoLab 5's are still in the range of a decent used car (even given our 25% sales tax + 180% duty on cars) - thats somewhat out of the price range I want to spend on HIFI equipment. :-/

No biggie though. I'm happy enough with my NAD ampl. and was thinking of buying a NAD DVD player; although I guess buying a PlayStation 3 has taken priority now ;-)
